scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
